mentions.name: Small Swarm/K3s in-between orchestrator
mentions.description: A lightweight container orchestrator positioned between Docker Swarm and K3s—less annoying than Swarm but lighter than K3s.
mentions.problem: Docker Swarm is annoying to use while K3s is too much (too heavy/complex).
mentions.source_excerpt: A small orchestrator for when Swarm is annoying but K3S is just too much!

evidence.value: A small orchestrator for when Swarm is annoying but K3S is just too much!
